items.title: Fossil-fuel industry accused of violating Colorado law over not disclosing drilling chemicals

items.title: US Democrats flip Alaska Senate seat as Mary Peltola wins race
items.description: The US Senate's final outstanding midterm election race has been won by Mary Peltola. She unseats Republican Dan Sullivan after winning 50.1% of the vote.

items.title: Nvidia forms national security committee after Huang affair
items.description: Nvidia has created a board-level committee for national security and export control. This follows the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang over extramarital affairs, allegedly including one with a Chinese intelligence asset.
